applicability.subject: january_anchor_and_event_checks_under_different_player_choices
applicability.finding: The anchor source defines historical observations, not source-conditioned player-choice exemptions. The player contract keeps protected/history gates hard. A waiver or conditional applicability rule needs governing authority and a predeclared condition. RBiH currently passes the measured January subset; RS and HRHB remain unreached.

applicability.subject: farz_gate
applicability.finding: Farz is a week-188 hard gate for all three player campaigns. The accepted rule permits either 2nd or 3rd Corps to make the final blow, requires the four authored late operation capture receipts and RBiH control at week 188, and treats 2nd Corps participation as diagnostic. No retained player campaign reaches it.

applicability.subject: score_700
applicability.finding: The retained t39 score is diagnostic only. It is neither a player floor nor a replacement for hard gates.

sameInput.finding: The actual result contains event-choice receipts and other action-specific records, but no standalone complete ordered action/input/command transcript and no production replay consumer binding. Save/load proves serialization/hydration at one point and cannot establish repeated identical production inputs. Equal seed/autonomy is insufficient because selected-player authorization changes phase inputs.

retiredComparator.finding: native_calibration_outcome_compare reconstructs n94 and compares the player run to it. Its protected set is the 712 cells equal across n91/n92/n94, not the canonical protected-control contract, and it hard-codes the retired score/equality checks. Its health object omits the full engine_health_gate contract. Keep its output diagnostic; do not use it as player pass/fail or protected/health proof.

canonicalReaders.finding: engine_health_gate and verify_checkpoints expect a complete 188-style run directory with run_summary, final_save, weekly reports, operation AARs, and checkpoints. The t39 player artifact shape cannot be qualified by those readers without a source-authorized player reader/adaptor.

crossFactionOpeningPreflight.finding: The harness has faction and historical-selector fixtures, but map counter coverage samples up to 12 formations dynamically from the current runtime and reduces the target to the available sample. It does not establish a frozen required all-faction counter set. Recruitment is enforced only with strategic/auto-recruit/require-recruitment flags, which the t39 command did not use. The retained RBiH opening proves 11/11 available members of a frozen 12-member RBiH set, with 17th Vitezka unavailable; it does not admit an RS or HRHB native launch.

cheapestRejectingNextStep.why: Existing retained files already reject claiming same-input qualification and reject assuming that RS/HRHB openings meet the frozen player-surface contract. A new zero-turn Save/load run would test a prerequisite already evidenced and would not close either dependency.

existingChecksFirst.purpose: Reject a syntactically invalid current harness without launching the game.

Confirm the retained faction/choice/counter fixtures and comparator behavior before adding any qualification reader. These tests do not themselves prove production player replay or all-faction opening coverage.

requiredImplementation.need: A read-only, source-authorized player input-contract reader plus production-shaped all-faction opening fixtures. The reader must enumerate every mutating player input in order, bind actor/faction/turn/options/selection/receipt and adjacent settled archives, and name the production replay consumer/serialization. Fixtures must bind a frozen required counter set and recruitment/choice expectations per faction rather than a dynamic sample.

prerequisites: Owner/source authority for the new read-only qualification contract and any applicability rules
Exact retained raw-result and manifest hashes
A declared frozen required counter/recruitment/choice set for RBiH, RS, and HRHB
A real production replay input consumer or an explicit result that none exists
passCriteria: Every state-mutating player action is complete, ordered, actor/faction/turn bound, receipt bound, and associated with comparable settled archives
The transcript serialization is consumed by the production replay path without reselection
All three faction opening fixtures satisfy the frozen counter, choice, proposal, reserve, officer, and recruitment contract
Output is deterministic JSON with exact source/result/manifest provenance
cheapestRejectingNextStep.expectedCost: Seconds to about three minutes of offline Node checks; zero native minutes.
cheapestRejectingNextStep.stoppingRule: Stop at the first missing, unordered, unbound, or non-replay-consumable input class; or the first faction whose frozen opening set/selector cannot be proven. Record MISSING_REPLAYABLE_INPUT_CONTRACT or OPENING_CONTRACT_UNQUALIFIED. Do not launch or retry a native campaign. There is currently no valid existing native command that can satisfy the same-input gate because the harness has no demonstrated production replay-input consumer.
